+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -12,5 +12,38 @@
     tau_filter: float,
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
-
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate inputs
+    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)) or isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")
+    if tau_filter < 0 or not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite nonnegative")
+    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
+                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
+                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
+        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
+        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values")
+        if (arr > 0).any():
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonpositive")
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError("all logp matrices must have the same shape")
+    H = logp_with_result.shape[1]
+    n = logp_with_result.shape[0]
+    t = np.arange(H, dtype=float)
+    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
+    weight_sum = raw_weights.sum()
+    if weight_sum == 0:
+        raise ValueError("normalization sum is zero")
+    norm_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum
+    loss_with = -np.dot(logp_with_result, norm_weights)
+    loss_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, norm_weights)
+    loss_no_call = -np.dot(logp_no_call, norm_weights)
+    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)
+    margin = L_minus - loss_with
+    keep = margin >= tau_filter
+    return keep, margin.astype(float)
